compound create/intake UI latency contains three ordered POSTs; first-request backend time is not total action backend time
per-run wall-clock elapsed includes login/assertion/operator/reload; never used as save-action latency
no source write or HMR change during measured runs; dev/instrumentation overhead remains and is explicitly bounded, not subtracted as if production performance
